Calculate Theoretical Performance and Ratios ---\n    dofs_per_rank = total_dofs / total_ranks\n    max_cores_on_node = cores_per_node * threading_hint\n    cpu_per_rank = max_cores_on_node // total_ranks if nodes_used == 1 else cores_per_node\n\n    scaling_efficiency = math.tanh(dofs_per_rank / efficiency_sweet_spot)\n    effective_fom_per_core = ideal_fom_per_core * scaling_efficiency\n    theoretical_max_fom = effective_fom_per_core * total_ranks * cpu_per_rank\n\n    performance_ratio = 0.0\n    if theoretical_max_fom > 1e-9:\n        performance_ratio = current_fom / theoretical_max_fom\n\n    estimated_memory_gb = total_dofs / dofs_per_gb\n    memory_utilization = estimated_memory_gb / (memory_gb_per_node * nodes_used)\n\n    metrics = {\n        \"performance_ratio\": round(performance_ratio, 3),\n        \"scaling_efficiency\": round(scaling_efficiency, 3),\n        \"memory_utilization\": round(memory_utilization, 3),\n        \"dofs_per_rank\": int(dofs_per_rank),\n        \"theoretical_max_fom\": f\"{theoretical_max_fom:.2e}\"\n    }\n    # --- 3. Decision Logic based on prioritized bottlenecks ---        \n    # Primary STOP condition: Performance is good enough.\n    if performance_ratio >= threshold:\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"STOP\",\n            \"reason\": f\"Optimization goal reached. Current performance is at {performance_ratio:.1%} of the theoretical maximum, meeting the {threshold:.1%} threshold.\",\n            \"metrics\": metrics\n        }\n\n    # Primary RETRY condition: Memory is the bottleneck.\n    if memory_utilization >= memory_safety_factor:\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"RETRY\",\n            \"reason\": f\"Memory utilization is critically high at {memory_utilization:.1%}. The problem size is too large for the allocated memory. Suggest significantly reducing the problem size.\",\n            \"metrics\": metrics\n        }\n\n    # Secondary RETRY condition: Scaling is the bottleneck.\n    if scaling_efficiency < 0.5: # Heuristic for \"low\" efficiency\n         return {\n            \"decision\": \"RETRY\",\n            \"reason\": f\"Scaling efficiency is low ({scaling_efficiency:.1%}), indicating the problem size per rank is too small. Suggest significantly increasing the problem size to provide more work per rank.\",\n            \"metrics\": metrics\n        }\n\n    # Tertiary RETRY condition: Cores are underutilized on a single node.\n    if nodes_used == 1 and total_ranks < max_cores_on_node:\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"RETRY\",\n            \"reason\": f\"The node is under-subscribed ({total_ranks}/{max_cores_on_node} tasks used). Suggest increasing the number of tasks to better utilize the hardware.\",\n            \"metrics\": metrics\n        }\n\n    # Default RETRY condition: Performance is simply not good enough yet.\n    return {\n        \"decision\": \"RETRY\",\n        \"reason\": f\"Performance is at {performance_ratio:.1%} of theoretical max, which is below the {threshold:.1%} threshold. # Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    make \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libgomp1 && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Compile the application using the MPI compiler wrapper
    cd /opt/amg2023-src/src && \
    make && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # FIX: Install hypre development library to provide required header files (HYPRE_config.h).
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root as the Makefile is located here.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    make && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # Install hypre development library to provide required header files and libraries.
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # FIX: Build by overriding hardcoded Makefile paths for INCLUDES and LIBRARIES
    # to point to the correct locations for the system-installed hypre package.
    make INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" LIBRARIES="-lHYPRE -lm" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # Install hypre development library to provide required header files and libraries.
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # FIX: The default Makefile is hardcoded for a GPU environment (CUDA/Umpire).
    # Use sed to modify the Makefile for a standard CPU build.
    # 1. Comment out the entire block defining GPU-specific library paths.
    sed -i '/# for systems with CUDA/,/-Wl,-rpath,${HYPRE_DIR}\/lib/s/^/#/' Makefile && \
    # 2. Uncomment the line that correctly sets LIBRARIES for a standard system hypre install.
    sed -i 's/^#LIBRARIES = -lHYPRE -lm/LIBRARIES = -lHYPRE -lm/' Makefile && \
    # 3. Build the application, still providing the INCLUDES path.
    make INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # Install hypre development library to provide required header files and libraries.
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # FIX: The Makefile is hardcoded for specific GPU environments.
    # Override the INCLUDES and LIBRARIES variables on the make command line
    # to force a generic CPU build using the installed system libraries. This is more
    # robust than attempting to patch the Makefile with sed.
    make INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" LIBRARIES="-lHYPRE -lm" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # Install hypre development library to provide required header files and libraries.
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # FIX: The Makefile is hardcoded for specific GPU environments.
    # Override INCLUDES, LFLAGS, and LIBRARIES on the make command line.
    # Setting LFLAGS="" prevents the Makefile from adding GPU-specific library paths.
    # Setting LIBRARIES forces linking against only the required system libraries.
    make INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" LFLAGS="" LIBRARIES="-lHYPRE -lm" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # Install hypre development library to provide required header files and libraries.
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # FIX: Add -fopenmp to the linker flags. The hypre library is built with OpenMP
    # support, and this flag is required to link against it successfully, resolving
    # 'undefined reference' errors to hypre functions.
    make INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" LFLAGS="" LIBRARIES="-lHYPRE -lm -fopenmp" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # Install hypre development library to provide required header files and libraries.
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # FIX: Use the mpicc compiler wrapper (CC=mpicc) to correctly link this MPI
    # application with the MPI-enabled HYPRE library. This ensures MPI's own
    # linker flags are included, resolving the 'undefined reference' errors.
    make CC=mpicc INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" LIBRARIES="-lHYPRE -lm -fopenmp" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # Install hypre development library to provide required header files and libraries.
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # FIX: Explicitly disable the CUDA build path by setting USE_CUDA=0.
    # The Makefile was incorrectly attempting a GPU build, causing linker
    # errors for missing CUDA libraries in this CPU-only environment.
    # The INCLUDES override is still needed to point to the system hypre headers.
    make CC=mpicc USE_CUDA=0 INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # Install hypre development library to provide required header files and libraries.
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # FIX: The default Makefile contains hardcoded paths and assumes a GPU
    # environment (CUDA+Umpire). Override CXX, disable CUDA and Umpire, and
    # explicitly set library/include paths to build a portable CPU version.
    make CXX=mpic++ USE_CUDA=0 USE_UMPIRE=0 INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" LIBS="-lHYPRE -lm" RPATH="" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # The hypre library is a core dependency for amg2023
    libhypre-dev \
    # OpenMPI for parallel execution
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Build the application. The Makefile is hardcoded for specific HPC environments
    # (assuming GPU, Umpire, and non-standard paths). We must override these
    # defaults to build a portable CPU version with system-installed libraries.
    make CXX=mpic++ \
         USE_CUDA=0 \
         USE_UMPIRE=0 \
         INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" \
         LIBS="-lHYPRE -lm" \
         RPATH="" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # The hypre library is a core dependency for amg2023
    libhypre-dev \
    # OpenMPI for parallel execution
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Build the application. The Makefile is hardcoded for specific HPC environments
    # (assuming GPU, Umpire, and non-standard paths). We must override these
    # defaults to build a portable CPU version with system-installed libraries.
    make CXX=mpic++ \
         USE_CUDA=0 \
         USE_UMPIRE=0 \
         INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" \
         LIBS="-lHYPRE -lm" \
         RPATH="" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

# Dockerfile for amg2023 for AWS CPU Kubernetes Environment
# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) provides a modern, stable OS
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies, clone source, build, install, and clean up in a single layer.
# This approach minimizes the final image size and leverages layer caching effectively.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    # The hypre library is a core dependency for amg2023
    libhypre-dev \
    # OpenMPI for parallel execution in a containerized environment
    libopenmpi-dev \
    make \
    openmpi-bin && \
    # Clone the latest default branch of the application repository
    git clone https://github.com/llnl/amg2023.git /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Change to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd /opt/amg2023-src && \
    # Build the application. The Makefile is hardcoded for specific HPC environments
    # (assuming GPU, Umpire, and non-standard paths). We must override these
    # defaults to build a portable CPU version with system-installed libraries.
    make CXX=mpic++ \
         USE_CUDA=0 \
         USE_UMPIRE=0 \
         INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" \
         LIBS="-lHYPRE -lm" \
         RPATH="" && \
    # Copy the compiled executable to a standard location in the system PATH
    # The 'install' command is used here to set correct permissions
    install amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up build-time artifacts and package manager cache
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023-src && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set a default working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /data

# Set the default command. The amg binary is now in the PATH.
# This allows for direct execution or use with an MPI launcher like mpirun.
# Example for MPI execution in Kubernetes: `command: ["mpirun", "-np", "4", "amg", "-r", "20", "20", "20"]`
ENTRYPOINT ["amg"]

Optimization Analysis

Figure of Merit (FOM) Progression

Lower is better. A value of 0.0 indicates a failed run for that attempt.
